content_of_post_to_comment: Watched Master and Commander recently - and it turns out it’s as good as everyone says. Have to say I particularly love the presentation of religion in the film. The prayers aren’t flashy and attention-seeking, nor are they a convenient absence which make no comment on faith whatsoever. Religion is just there, strong and foundational. Russell Crowe is also cool.
comment: There’s something interesting about faith being part of the crew’s routine rather than the film’s argument. It makes religion feel less like a position to defend and more like a world people actually inhabit.
